name: Round timer: heat, break, repeat, final cool-down
info:
Press "Start" to run the session. "Round timer" sends one message at the start of each part.
Change rounds / heat / rest (minutes) in the Start inject. Replace the "Notify" debug node with your
notification node (Home Assistant, Telegram, Pushover, e-mail...). It gets msg.title and msg.payload as text.

The "Test run" inject sends msg.minuteMs = 1000, so a whole session takes seconds instead of an hour.

name: Round timer
Phase message
Sauna is ready: one notification when the room reaches the target
info:
Wire your temperature reading into "Sauna is ready?" (a Home Assistant state node, an MQTT in node...).
msg.payload must be the number, in the same unit as the target. Set the target and unit in "Set target".
It notifies once, then re-arms after the room cools 5 degrees below the target.
